rationale: Targeted re-check of the 3 findings from code-review-final.json against the fix-up diff (reviewed_head 3ebfc9ce..HEAD). CR-002 (saveProfile full-replace risk) is fixed: saveProfile() now merges onto the existing stored profile. CR-003 (as-any casts in migration 008) is fixed: migration rewritten to handle the three identity fields explicitly, typecheck and lint both clean. CR-001 (claimed local-profile regression) was investigated further rather than patched: two new regression tests prove the concern does not reproduce in any reachable config state — load() already merges a global profile's own identity before resolveProfileWorkspace()'s workspace fallback runs, so the fallback never clobbers it; the one genuinely unreachable edge case (a local-only profile with no global counterpart and no identity of its own) degrades gracefully to no identity, confirmed by a dedicated test, not a crash or a leaked value. All 4 touched/new test files pass (148 tests), typecheck is clean, lint is clean, pre-commit hooks (including gitleaks) passed on the fix-up commit. Minor residual note, not blocking: saveProfile()'s new merge semantics mean a field can no longer be cleared from a profile via saveProfile() alone (only added/overwritten) — acceptable since the single real caller (setup.ts) always passes a superset of the profile's intended fields and never clears one.

finding_status.notes: Verified not reproducible in any reachable state via 2 new regression tests (src/utils/__tests__/config-project-override.test.ts: 'falls back to the matching global profile's own identity...' and 'resolves no identity ... for a purely local-only profile ...'); no production code change needed or made for this finding.

saveProfile() in src/utils/config.ts now merges {...config.profiles[profileName], ...profileFields} instead of replacing outright. Confirmed via new regression test; full config-project-override.test.ts suite (31/31) still passes.

src/migrations/008-isolate-global-profile-identity.migration.ts rewritten with explicit per-field hasIdentity/withIdentityFrom/withoutIdentity helpers; zero `as any` casts remain. tsc --noEmit and eslint --max-warnings=0 both clean. Migration's own 4 tests still pass.
